title: 新手引导与机制说明不足
description: 游戏缺少有效的教程、引导和机制说明，玩家难以理解核心玩法、系统和操作，需要依赖试错或外部资源，导致上手困难。
evidence: The tutorial provided no guidance on salvaging or construction
It's in dire need of a proper tutorial

evidence_items.quote: the tutorial for the game is super inadequate
evidence_items.description: 游戏教程非常不充分
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的教程超级不充分

evidence_items.quote: the tutorial ends abruptly after touching on just the basics
evidence_items.description: 教程在只涉及基础内容后突然结束
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程在仅仅触及基础内容后就戛然而止

evidence_items.quote: a competent but incomplete tutorial that gets you far enough to just be frustrated at everything else that's unexplained
evidence_items.description: 教程不完整，很多机制未解释
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个称职但不完整的新手教程，它让你走得足够远，结果只是让你对其它一切未解释的内容感到沮丧

evidence_items.quote: Tutorial is non-existant and sends you down a rabbit-hole of confusion.
evidence_items.description: 教程缺失，导致玩家陷入困惑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程根本不存在，让你陷入困惑的兔子洞。

evidence_items.quote: Обучение очень слабое и кривое.
evidence_items.description: 教程非常薄弱且扭曲
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程非常薄弱且扭曲。

evidence_items.quote: So so much is not explained.  Figuring out just where to go to even sleep is not explained in any meaningful way.
evidence_items.description: 游戏机制缺乏解释，如睡觉地点和气压维持
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有太多太多东西没有解释。连到底该去哪里睡觉都没有以任何有意义的方式说明。

evidence_items.quote: the tutorial and 22 hours of gameplay don't show that there is much more than that
evidence_items.description: 教程和22小时游玩未展示出游戏宣传中的更多内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程和22小时的游戏时间并没有显示出还有远不止这些的内容

evidence_items.quote: No lead in/short tutorial for mining.
evidence_items.description: 采矿缺乏引导或简短教程
evidence_items.quote_zh: 采矿没有引导/简短教程。

evidence_items.quote: Tutorial is nonexistent, very complex.
evidence_items.description: 游戏没有教程，内容非常复杂
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程根本不存在，非常复杂。

evidence_items.quote: 因为这个教程迟早会过时
evidence_items.description: 教程迟早会过时
evidence_items.quote_zh: 因为这个教程迟早会过时

evidence_items.quote: The tutorial is still  broken, just stops guideance after the docking on the first derelict
evidence_items.description: 教程在第一次对接后停止指导
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程仍然是坏的，在第一次对接废弃飞船后就停止引导了

evidence_items.quote: lack of proper guidance in-game (was watching hours of guides of what little good ones there was on youtube)
evidence_items.description: 游戏内缺乏引导，玩家需要看大量外部指南
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏内缺乏适当的引导（我当时在YouTube上看了好几个小时那些为数不多的好攻略）

evidence_items.quote: some things aren't very well explained and you either have to ask someone or do the trial and error method
evidence_items.description: 部分机制缺乏说明，只能靠询问或试错
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些东西解释得不太清楚，你要么得问别人，要么就得用反复试错的方法

evidence_items.quote: the tutorial doesn't tell you that your starting tools are worthless and there's better ones you can get right away etc, it also happens after you've softlocked yourself in the character creator in which you have no real idea what is good or bad
evidence_items.description: 教程未告知初始工具无用及可获取更好工具，也未在角色创建时提供有效指导
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程没有告诉你，你的初始工具毫无价值，而且有更好的工具你可以立刻获得等等，它还发生在你已经在角色创建器中把自己卡死之后，那时你根本不知道什么是好什么是坏

evidence_items.quote: needs more tutorial feautures
evidence_items.description: 教程内容不足，需要更多教程功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 需要更多教程功能

evidence_items.quote: None of this is explained to you and you have to figure it all out on your own.
evidence_items.description: 游戏机制完全没有解释
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这些内容没有任何一项会向你解释，你必须全靠自己摸索清楚。

evidence_items.quote: I lied, there is no tutorial.
evidence_items.description: 没有教程，所有内容都需自行摸索
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我撒谎了，根本没有教程。

evidence_items.quote: You need to do a lot of reading and the like before you can really play this be warned.
evidence_items.description: 需要大量阅读才能开始游玩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在真正能玩这款游戏之前，你需要做大量阅读之类的事情，提前警告你。

evidence_items.quote: if you really need things explained to you with a detailed tutorial, you might need to wait a while yet for this game to be for you
evidence_items.description: 缺少详细教程，需要等待后续更新
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你真的需要别人用详细教程来给你解释各种东西，那你可能还得再等上一阵子，这款游戏才会适合你

evidence_items.quote: explains none of the mechanics
evidence_items.description: 游戏未解释任何机制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有解释任何机制

evidence_items.quote: The tutorial is okay. I feel it needs alot of work. While i was able to get through it pretty easy, I could see how the average player may get lost in it
evidence_items.description: 教程需要大量改进，普通玩家可能会迷失。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程还行。我觉得它需要大量改进。虽然我能够相当轻松地通过它，但我能看出普通玩家可能会在其中迷失方向

evidence_items.quote: Really cool conversation system but convoluted and hard to understand
evidence_items.description: 对话系统复杂且难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话系统真的很酷，但复杂又难以理解

evidence_items.quote: awful tutorial
evidence_items.description: 教程质量差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 糟糕的教程

evidence_items.quote: 最大的缺点是没有新手教程，新人开局就连怎么选中开启箱子都要研究一下
evidence_items.description: 游戏没有新手教程，新人开局连怎么选中开启箱子都要研究。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 最大的缺点是没有新手教程，新人开局就连怎么选中开启箱子都要研究一下

evidence_items.quote: i don't even understand any think from the tutorial
evidence_items.description: 教程难以理解，无法从中学会任何东西。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我甚至完全看不懂教程里的任何东西

evidence_items.quote: The tutorial provided no guidance on salvaging or construction
evidence_items.description: 教程没有解释如何打捞或建造。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程没有提供任何关于打捞或建造的指导

evidence_items.quote: There is an interesting character creation process, but its rather limited, and without knowing what anything does its less fun
evidence_items.description: 角色创建过程有趣但选项有限，且不清楚功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一个有趣的角色创建过程，但它相当有限，而且在不了解任何东西的作用的情况下，它就没那么有趣了

evidence_items.quote: there are minimal tutorials
evidence_items.description: 游戏内教程极少，需要看手册或视频才能学会机制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 几乎没有教程

evidence_items.quote: there's not in game reference material for everytihng, only Out of game
evidence_items.description: 游戏内没有参考材料，只有游戏外资料
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里没有关于所有内容的参考资料，只有游戏外的

evidence_items.quote: The tutorial currently lacks the necessary guidance and can lead to early failures
evidence_items.description: 教程缺乏必要引导，容易导致早期失败
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程目前缺乏必要的指导，可能导致早期失败

evidence_items.quote: The game suffers from a distinct lack of "show don't tell" There is a user manual, which promises more documentation to come.
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏展示而非讲述，依赖大量文档
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏明显缺乏“展示而非讲述”。有一本用户手册，承诺会有更多文档推出。

evidence_items.quote: lacks tutorials/explanations/wiki-information that you need to get by without trial and error
evidence_items.description: 缺少教程、说明和wiki信息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 缺乏让你无需反复试错就能上手的教程/说明/wiki信息

evidence_items.quote: This game doesn't really explain much to you when you are first starting out
evidence_items.description: 游戏初期缺乏解释
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏在你刚开始玩的时候并没有真正向你解释太多东西

evidence_items.quote: the tutorial will leave you hanging on certain things, you will have to discover them on your own thru trial and error
evidence_items.description: 教程对某些内容没有说明，需要自行摸索
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程会在某些事情上让你悬着，你得靠自己的试错去发现它们

evidence_items.quote: Needs a bit more help to know how to use systems such as what do you do when you fix a derelict?  How do you take it?
evidence_items.description: 修复废弃船后缺乏后续指引
evidence_items.quote_zh: 需要更多帮助来了解如何使用系统，比如当你修好一艘废弃飞船时该做什么？你怎么把它带走？

evidence_items.quote: this game is in DIRE need of a way, WAY more comprehensive tutorial than what it offers.  Unless I somehow managed to softlock the tutorial 3 times in a row, the amount of things that are actually explained to the player are next to NONE compared to everything you definitely, DEFINITELY need to know.
evidence_items.description: 教程内容严重不足，未解释必要知识
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏极度、极度需要一个比现在所提供的要全面得多的教程。除非我不知怎么连续三次把教程卡死了，否则实际上向玩家解释的东西，跟你绝对、绝对需要知道的一切相比，几乎等于没有。

evidence_items.quote: Last thing I want to add is I think the tutorial could be improved, especially with the ship maintenance and what it requires to function. Instead of telling the player to immediately fly out after fixing the navigation there could be some explaining of how you need to watch your batteries for power and similar finite ship resources like oxygen and fuel and more on how you do maintenance. My first run after doing the practice flying of the tutorial I had no power left when I docked to a wreck and got stuck.
evidence_items.description: 教程未充分解释飞船维护和资源管理，导致玩家在对接残骸时因电力耗尽而卡住
evidence_items.quote_zh: 最后我想补充的是，我认为教程可以改进，尤其是在飞船维护以及它运转所需的条件方面。与其在修好导航后就让玩家立刻飞出去，不如解释一下你需要留意电池电量，以及氧气和燃料等类似的有限飞船资源，还有更多关于如何进行维护的内容。我第一次在教程里做完飞行练习后，停靠到一艘残骸上时电力耗尽，结果卡住了。

evidence_items.quote: has a not-so-great tutorial
evidence_items.description: 教程质量不佳
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一个不太好的教程

evidence_items.quote: it needs a good tutorial as very little is self-evident
evidence_items.description: 缺少教程，很多内容不直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它需要一个好的教程，因为很少有东西是不言自明的

evidence_items.quote: There are manuals in-game full of immersive irrelevant larping fluff, but nothing that matters is explained anywhere
evidence_items.description: 游戏内手册只含无关内容，关键信息无处解释
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里有满是沉浸式无关角色扮演废话的手册，但任何重要的事情都没有在任何地方得到解释

evidence_items.quote: No idea what I'm doing in this game, short of repairing ships.
evidence_items.description: 缺少教程，玩家不知道如何游玩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 完全不知道我在这个游戏里在干什么，除了修理飞船。

evidence_items.quote: I wish there was a tutorial of some kind, at least
evidence_items.description: 缺少教程，玩家难以了解游戏机制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我希望至少能有某种教程

evidence_items.quote: The clear goals to achieve are still missing at this stage of development
evidence_items.description: 当前开发阶段缺少明确目标
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在当前的开发阶段，明确的达成目标仍然缺失

evidence_items.quote: There's basically nothing for a tutorial
evidence_items.description: 几乎没有新手教程
evidence_items.quote_zh: 基本上没有任何教程

evidence_items.quote: The manual is a bit limited at the moment, so there's a lot of troubleshooting and finding things through trial and error.
evidence_items.description: 游戏手册内容有限，需要大量试错和排查
evidence_items.quote_zh: 目前手册有点有限，所以有很多需要排查问题和通过反复试错来摸索的地方。

evidence_items.quote: the game is so vague in its systems that it is literally rocket science
evidence_items.description: 游戏系统过于模糊，难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏的系统如此含糊不清，简直就像火箭科学一样

evidence_items.quote: Aside from the very beginning there are virtually no tutorials (with the exception of the nav system cheatsheet)
evidence_items.description: 除导航系统小抄外几乎没有教程
evidence_items.quote_zh: 除了最开始的部分，几乎没有任何教程（导航系统速查表除外）

evidence_items.quote: It's in dire need of a proper tutorial
evidence_items.description: 缺少合适的教程
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它急需一个像样的教程

evidence_items.quote: very little information on how to play it
evidence_items.description: 游戏内几乎没有玩法说明，开局缺乏引导
evidence_items.quote_zh: 关于如何游玩的信息非常少

evidence_items.quote: There is no tutorial and the learning curve is very steep.
evidence_items.description: 没有教程，学习曲线非常陡峭。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有教程，而且学习曲线非常陡峭。
